SRC-234:R001.text: Inspect live repository, HEAD, dirty state, admission gates, and backlog

SRC-234:R002.text: Check existing execution, recovery, tool-use, and validation contracts without duplicating findings, rules, tasks, or mechanisms

SRC-234:R003.text: Evaluate recovery contract on tool schema validation failure: inspect available tool contract, correct argument types, avoid blind retries, stop and report after repeated failures

SRC-234:R004.text: Evaluate recovery contract on read-before-write rejection: read target file, establish current content, retry against valid current state

SRC-234:R005.text: Evaluate recovery contract on stale-write rejection: reread, reconcile concurrent changes, preserve optimistic concurrency guards

SRC-234:R006.text: Evaluate recovery contract on completed task operations: distinguish idempotent terminal state from real failure without manufacturing false blockers

SRC-234:R007.text: Strengthen protocol validation evidence handling: preserve actual validator exit status, preserve attributable conformance receipts, resolve installed instance identity

SRC-234:R008.text: Add positive and negative regression controls covering schema correction, bounded retry, read-before-edit, stale edit, task stop, pipelined validator hiding, duplicate installations

SRC-234:R009.text: Compare proposed normative change against existing authority: record host ownership boundary where enforcement belongs to ZAICODE and do not falsely claim SAIPEN enforces host behaviors

SRC-234:R010.text: No modification of ZAICODE or FREEBUFF_SAI source, no rewriting historical evidence, no inventing rule identifiers, no modifying DONE project without authorization
